title: consolida regalis var. divaricata
intro: Consolida regalis var. divaricata, commonly known as Rocket Larkspur or Western Delphinium, is a perennial plant native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Consolida regalis var. divaricata include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it a potential treatment for various respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
